title: Rootline walkthrough: irrigation, lighting and other service lines
description: A clickable walkthrough of a multi-line landscape company in Columbus: turning service lines on, an irrigation start-up wave held for a freeze, a start-up visit with a pre-authorized repair, a backflow test, a smart-controller leak alert, an 811 dig gate with no override, a warranty claim, a lighting service plan with voltage readings, holiday lighting sold from an AI concept, a mosquito program and tree care as a later module.
